verdict.rationale: Productboard's core data model explicitly links feedback/insights to features, initiatives, releases, and objectives — docs describe auto-detecting insights linkable to feature ideas, associating feedback with features/components, and adding features to initiatives or moving them to releases via API/MCP. This directly matches the story of connecting feedback to roadmap items across the hierarchy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and no explicit UI walkthrough evidence (only API/MCP references).
